datePolicy: Retains the source-specific November 6, 2026 local planning/access date. Original tool timestamps were November 5, 2026 approximately 21:49–22:05 UTC (November 6 Asia/Singapore). Copy drafting and arithmetic checks on November 6 are not external rechecks. No publication date or unknown model invented.
uncertainties: All hotel rates are official advertised from rates, not July 9–12, 2027 family quotes or inventory. Dated engines returned no usable quotes, not evidence of sold out; £660 is a target. Reem accompanied-under-18 conditions, final taxes/breakfast remain unconfirmed; two double beds require teen sharing. Euro stairs/lower-ground and Darlington unlisted AC matter.

Heathrow and Bloomsbury are assumptions. All journeys, queues, flight processing, walking, £65 Watford rail, food, airport margin and extras are estimates, not checked July timetables or fare quotes. Fares, works and actual flights need confirmation.

Arsenal live table £36/£26 prevails over £34 tile; current from rates, not July slots. Adult concession £31 is not assumed. Oyster specific £10.50 prevails over £10 general page. Young Visitor is for the younger teen only; adult-rate older teen deliberately used.

Four suitable £29.50 theatre seats are not found or held. Wednesday June 30, 2027 release is a calendar inference if the current scheme continues, not an announced July sale. Disney two-ticket limit is unsuitable as a four-person foundation.

Studio Tour is a costed alternative replacing Sunday, excluded from base. Published 2027 admission is £231 for three adult-rate travellers and one child; £65 rail is estimated and added while retaining central travel allowance. Date-specific availability unverified. Both attractions at £660 lodging exceed envelope by £76.90; affordable variants leave £43.10.

Entry applies to ordinary Canadian tourists with stated exceptions, not Chinese passports. ETA is not guaranteed admission. Future fee/rules and individual immigration history/status must be checked; passport valid whole stay, no blanket six-month remaining-validity requirement. No immigration or legal advice.

Original session limitation retained: initial Arsenal/Museum managed-browser reads and one automatic TfL managed fallback were not clean-session reads. Subsequent fresh non-persistent contexts started with zero cookies; no everyday sign-ins imported. British Museum clean repeat received 403; official-domain excerpts corroborated admission/hours/advance recommendation. Visit London security page was not full-page evidence. No claim of fresh external verification by this drafting task.
